blurb: Cove Harbor Marina offers boat storage including drystack storage with preparation and launch services. They provide wet slip rentals and various storage options including docks and lockers. The marina includes amenities such as a convenience store and offers the Admiral Plan for storage.
extraNote: Allow 1 hour Mon-Thur or 2 hours Fri-Sun to prepare boat · After hour returns: secure vessel to Launch/Fuel dock and place keys in drop box · All stays longer than 3 days incur electricity per kWh fee · Prices subject to change without notice · Right to refuse service to anyone at any time
